_note: Hand-extended from `grith --help` and every `grith <cmd> --help` on the v0.3.1 binary. The upstream generator walks the clap enum in crates/grith-core/src/main.rs and emits top-level commands only, so it produces "partial": true with no subcommands and no flags. Re-running `npm run gen:references` will drop the subcommand and flag detail below.

commands.description: Run the interactive first-run setup (welcome, provider, trial, guide)
commands.name: setup
init
commands.doc_note: Overwrites an existing config.toml unconditionally - no backup, no merge.

commands.name: config

subcommands.name: set
subcommands.description: Set a configuration value

commands.doc_note: Bare `grith config` prints the effective configuration. `set` accepts a fixed 58-key whitelist, not arbitrary dotted paths. There is no get, list, edit, validate or reload.

commands.name: audit

subcommands.name: diagnose
subcommands.description: Inspect the audit chain: verification outcome, forks, gaps (read-only)

subcommands.name: export
subcommands.description: Export audit logs as JSON or CSV

subcommands.name: compact
subcommands.description: Reclaim free pages left by pruning: rewrites + atomically swaps the audit database. A manual maintenance op (never automatic); requires that no daemon is running and the chain is not quarantined

subcommands.name: rebuild-analytics
subcommands.description: Rebuild the analytics projection from the audit database and cold archives

commands.doc_note: `export` writes data to stdout and its count banner to stderr, so redirecting to a file gives clean output. `compact` and `rebuild-analytics` both refuse while the daemon owns the database, and both refuse on a quarantined chain; `diagnose` is the one that still works in quarantine.

commands.name: digest

subcommands.name: review
subcommands.description: Interactive digest review

commands.doc_note: In `review`, `q` auto-denies the item currently on screen before quitting.

commands.description: Manage canary tokens used for exfiltration trap detection
commands.name: canary

subcommands.name: list
subcommands.description: List registered canary tokens

subcommands.name: add
subcommands.description: Add a canary token

subcommands.name: remove
subcommands.description: Remove a canary token by ID

subcommands.name: rotate
subcommands.description: Rotate a canary token by ID (keeps label, replaces value)

commands.doc_note: The registry is in-memory. These subcommands mutate a throwaway registry the daemon never sees; the only durable registration is [[canary.tokens]] in config/filters/canary.toml plus a daemon restart.

commands.name: proxy

subcommands.name: test
subcommands.description: Dry-run a tool call against the proxy

commands.doc_note: `proxy test` exit codes: 0 allow, 1 queue, 2 deny.

commands.description: Supervise an external CLI tool with OS-level syscall interception
commands.name: exec
commands.doc_note: Also accepts three bare verbs - `list`, `kill <id>`, `prune` - matched only when there is no --, no --profile and no --attach. A fail-closed thin client: it refuses to start a session without a version-matched daemon, and has no in-process fallback.

commands.description: List or manage active supervisor sessions
commands.name: supervisor

subcommands.name: list
subcommands.description: List active supervisor sessions

subcommands.name: status
subcommands.description: Show details of a specific session

subcommands.name: kill
subcommands.description: Terminate a supervisor session and detach from the process

commands.description: Manage the grith daemon (dashboard server + shared subsystems)
commands.name: daemon

subcommands.name: start
subcommands.description: Start the daemon (dashboard server + shared subsystems) as a background process

subcommands.name: stop
subcommands.description: Stop the running daemon

subcommands.name: restart
subcommands.description: Restart the daemon (stop the running one, then start this build)

subcommands.name: status
subcommands.description: Check if the daemon is running

subcommands.name: pair
subcommands.description: Authorise a browser for the dashboard (mints a single-use pairing link)

commands.description: Manage Pro plan: login, status, sync, activate, logout
commands.name: pro

subcommands.name: login
subcommands.description: Authenticate with grith.ai (device auth by default, API key optional)

subcommands.name: status
subcommands.description: Show plan status, license expiry, team info

subcommands.name: activate
subcommands.description: Fetch and activate a fresh license

subcommands.name: refresh
subcommands.description: Force an on-demand license refresh against grith.ai

subcommands.name: logout
subcommands.description: Remove credentials and license

subcommands.name: sync
subcommands.description: Pull team policies, shared configs and provider keys; push learned reputation

subcommands.name: upgrade
subcommands.description: Open the upgrade/pricing page in the default browser

subcommands.name: start-trial
subcommands.description: Start a free Pro trial (one-click when available, else opens signup)

subcommands.name: billing
subcommands.description: Show current plan and billing details; open billing portal in browser

commands.doc_note: The binary's own --help text for `sync` still says "Upload audit records to cloud". That is stale: the raw audit-record upload was retired, and `sync` uploads no audit records. Without a licence, activate / refresh / billing / sync exit 1 with "Not logged in"; status reports it at exit 0.

commands.description: Manage cloud analytics sync for this machine
commands.name: analytics

subcommands.name: status
subcommands.description: Show cloud analytics sync status for this machine

subcommands.name: verify-archives
subcommands.description: Rebuild archived days from cloud storage and check they still match the analytics the server accepted

subcommands.name: enable
subcommands.description: Turn on cloud analytics sync (records your consent)

subcommands.name: disable
subcommands.description: Turn off cloud analytics sync on this machine

commands.doc_note: `verify-archives` defaults to yesterday back 29 days and exits non-zero when any day disagrees, so it can run as a check.

commands.name: notifications

subcommands.name: status
subcommands.description: Show notification channel status and health

subcommands.name: channels
subcommands.description: List all available notification channels

subcommands.name: test
subcommands.description: Send a test notification to a specific channel

commands.doc_note: Parked in v0.3.1. Every subcommand prints the same "Notifications are coming soon." message and exits 0.

commands.name: log
commands.doc_note: --session accepts a UUID or a session name. --limit defaults to 100 and is clamped.

commands.name: profile

subcommands.name: audit
subcommands.description: Audit a forensic trace file against a profile

commands.doc_note: `audit` is the only subcommand. There is no list, show, create, validate or diff - the profile set is compiled into the binary.

commands.name: reputation

subcommands.name: show
subcommands.description: Show the learned reputation table with trust scores

subcommands.name: reset
subcommands.description: Reset all learned reputation data

commands.doc_note: This is the learned Beta trust table, not the destination-reputation filter. It is applied after the pipeline and only on a QUEUE.

commands.description: Generate a shell completion script for grith
commands.name: completions
commands.doc_note: Works even when the config on disk is broken.

global_flags.description: Log level (trace, debug, info, warn, error)
Override the project name (defaults to current directory name)
Skip the first-run onboarding flow (also via GRITH_SKIP_ONBOARDING)

repl: Running `grith` with no arguments starts the interactive REPL.
